text:
carol.l: onboarding pegasus-lite13b-ql4 on canary. hitting intermittent OOMs for long generations (>6k).
dev.lee: paste error?
carol.l: snippet:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA OOM allocating KV cache chunk (1.2 GiB)
```
priyanka.s: did defaults change recently? max_new_tokens?
carol.l: manifest default is 4096 but some callers request up to 10k.
dev.lee: quick mitigations: 1) gateway soft-cap at 6k, 2) tighten microbatching (microbatch_size=1) or lower batch_window_ms to reduce simultaneous KV allocations, 3) KV heuristics: eviction_threshold 0.58, trim_ratio 0.15, compaction on.
carol.l: ran a small ablation (100 runs each): baseline -> 7 OOMs; cap2048+microbatch1 -> 0 OOMs but tail latency +35%; kv_eviction=0.58+compact true+microbatch2 -> 1 OOM, latency ~baseline.
priyanka.s: paste the config you tested?
carol.l: {"model":"pegasus-lite13b-ql4","defaults":{"max_new_tokens":4096},"batching":{"microbatch_size":2,"batch_window_ms":14},"kv":{"eviction_threshold":0.58,"trim_ratio":0.15,"compact":true},"prefetch":false}
dev.lee: looks good. Suggest kernel cutoff: avoid long-attn kernel for >4k unless caller opts-in. run long-context evals before changing kernels.
monitor-bot: canary deploy queued for pegasus-lite13b-ql4 tag canary/kv-0.58 at 2025-01-08T12:00:00Z.
priyanka.s: evals running (regressions + long-context). ETA ~20m.
carol.l: results: kv tweak -> ROUGE delta 0.04%, hallucination flat, OOMs near-zero.
dev.lee: plan: roll kv_eviction_threshold=0.58+trim_ratio=0.15+compact=true to canary 10%, keep default max_new_tokens=4096, add gateway soft-cap 6k with friendly 409 and docs link, manifest hard_cap=10k, and OOM alarm (auto-fallback to non-quant variant if OOM_rate>0.3%/hr).
ops-bot: canary ramp to 10% scheduled at 2025-01-08T12:30:00Z
